Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, and Terra sat down, with Sol and Luna secretly working as the killers. Gemma was voted out on day one for dodging questions, and Sol followed on day two after his denial of backing Gemma didn't hold up. On day three, Terra revealed as the officer and named Luna as a killer, but Sonnet, Haiku, and Luna voted Terra out, and Terra's claim died with her. Sonnet, the doctor, was then killed on night four, leaving Haiku and Luna level, so the killers won.
